paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash asi a, asik in atapa in vai ahawm hi.
heading: David In Ammonte Leh Siriate Azou / (2 Sam 10.1-19)
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

paite: David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih zel ziak in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi a. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in mite asawl hi. Huan David mite Ammon suante gam ah Hanun kiang ah amah lungmuan ding in ava tung uhi.
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

paite: Himahleh Ammon suan heutute'n Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a lungmuan ding mi na kiang a hon sawl hi in na gingta a hia? Amite gam hihse ding a enchian leh enkhe ding a na kiang a hong pai ahi khamoh ding uam maw?" achi uhi.
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

paite: Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul uh ametmaisak a, huan apuansilhte uh alaitak ah atobou uh khuhpha minmen in atansak a, apaisakta hi.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

paite: Huchi in kuate hiam in amite ana hihdan David ava hilh ua. Huan adawn ding in mi asawl a; amau lah azum mahmah ngal uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma Jeriko ah om unla, huai zoh chiang in hong kik un," achi hi.
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

paite: Huchi in Ammon suante'n David zakdah lam ana hihta uh chih akitheih un, Hanun leh Ammon suante'n Mesopotamia gam a mite, Siria-maakah a mite, Zobah a mite, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite goihna ding in dangkasik talent sangkhat akhak uhi.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

paite: Huchi in kangtalai singthum-le- sangnih, Maakah kumpipa leh amite toh api ua, Medeba kiang ah panmun abawlta uhi. Ammon suante akhua ua kipan apawtkhia ua, akikaikhawm ua, kidou ding in akuanta uhi.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

paite: David in huai azak in, Joab leh sepaih hangsante tengteng asawlkhia hi.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

paite: Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, khopi kongpi chin ah akiphalh ua, kumpipa amau thu a hong kuante atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

paite: Huchi in amalam leh nunglam ah ahon sual dek uh chih Joab in atheih in Israel mite lak a mi teltuamte atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in akizalh uhi.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

paite: Midang tengteng bel a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in amau leng akizalh uhi.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Siria mite ka zoh kei dekleh, hon panpih in; Ammon suante na zoh kei dekleh ka hon panpih ding.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

paite: Hangsantak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khuate hum in i kipasalsak ding uh; TOUPA'N hoih asak bang zel in hih hen," achi hi.
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”

paite: Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n kidouna mun a Siria mite ava naih ua; huchi in ama ah ataikekta uhi.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

paite: Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng a-unaupa Abishai ma ah ataikekta ua, khua ah alut uhi. Huchi in Joab Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

paite: Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah apang thei kei uh chih ana theih un, mi asawl ua, Lui khen lam a Siria pawlte asamkhia ua, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shophak bel aheutupen uh ahi.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

paite: Huai thu David ahilh ua; ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui akan ua, ava mu ua, sual ding in akiphalh uhi. Huchi in Siriate kidoupih dia David akisak khit in amah akidoupihta uhi.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

paite: Siria mite bel Israelte ma ah ataikek ua; David in Siria mi, kangtalai sangsagih tung a tuang leh sepaih singli athat a, sepaih heutu Shophak leng athat hi.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

paite: Huchi in Hadadezer mite'n Israelte ma ah apang theita kei uh chih atheih un, David toh kilemna abawl ua, asikhate ding in a-omta uh; Siria mite'n leng Ammon suante apanpih nuamta kei uhi.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
